name: Powersurge

global_influences.artist_or_genre: Metallica / Slayer / Megadeth / Exodus (American thrash metal)
global_influences.evidence: Founders Nahian and Samiul Islam explicitly formed the band in January 2006 drawing on American and German thrash/heavy metal influences; the band cites Metallica, Slayer, Megadeth and Exodus among core references.
Named alongside American acts as direct genre-founding influences on the band's sound.

global_influences.artist_or_genre: Lamb of God / Dream Theater / Pink Floyd
global_influences.evidence: Cited as additional inspirations shaping the band's groove-metal and more expansive compositional elements beyond straight thrash.

local_adaptation_notes: Powersurge situates itself within the 'East Bengal extreme metal scene,' rendering Bangla-language lyrics and thematic content (including on the liberation-war-adjacent underground scene) within a thrash/groove metal framework directly modeled on American and German genre pioneers, with comparatively less folk-fusion adaptation than acts like Artcell or Cryptic Fate.
sound_evolution_summary: Formative period (2006): formed by Nahian and Samiul Islam as a dedicated thrash metal project; gained public attention winning the D-Rockstar II talent competition in 2007. Debut album period (2008): Auprostut Juddho established the band's full-length thrash/groove metal identity, following the 2006 compilation single.
concert_culture_notes: Emerged through Dhaka's underground metal/rock talent-show and compilation-album circuit (D-Rockstar II, Underground mixed album), reflecting the mid-2000s underground metal scene's reliance on battle-of-the-bands events and mixed compilations for exposure.
listener_community_notes: Positioned as a pioneering thrash metal act within the Bangladeshi heavy metal ecosystem, appealing to listeners of the harder-edged extreme metal scene distinct from the more melodic/progressive metal audiences of Artcell or Karnival.

sources.title: Promoting thrash metal in Bangladeshi music scene — The Daily Star
